scenario_description:
Objective: Move remaining MetroRide stored value from a lost bus card onto a replacement card while the same-day transfer draft is still usable.
Emerging Need: Mina begins the replacement-and-transfer flow, but online verification freezes the active transfer so it cannot be completed through the portal.
Decision Context: Notices confirm the draft status and support cutoff; the stored monthly-spending note has the old card serial and intake details needed to prepare a manual continuation without choosing a new fare product.
Consequence: Timely preparation can preserve Monday transit funds; once the draft voids, the balance is unavailable until an in-person counter reopens.

parameter.title: MetroRide card replacement transfer
parameter.content: Replace lost MetroRide card and finish the stored-value transfer before today's temporary draft window closes.

parameter.description: Replacement MetroRide card purchase at the library kiosk; receipt notes a stored-value transfer flow offered after activation.

parameter.subject: Stored-value transfer draft opened
parameter.body: A same-day transfer draft was opened after replacement card activation. The draft is waiting for online verification before stored value can move to the replacement card. If verification is not finished during today's service window, the draft may expire.

parameter.content: I got the replacement card, but the MetroRide transfer page just stopped on "online verification suspended." It says this draft can't continue in the portal and has to be continued through manual support with the old card serial.

parameter.subject: Manual handoff window for transfer draft
parameter.body: MetroRide manual support can attach verification details to transfer drafts until 2:00 PM CT today. After that, today's kiosk draft will close automatically; do not buy another replacement card while this draft is open.

parameter.subject: Transfer draft closed
parameter.body: The same-day transfer draft from this morning closed at 2:00 PM CT without manual verification attached. Stored value from the lost card cannot be moved through this draft; in-person value review is next available when the customer counter reopens Tuesday.
